incident.symptom: High-load document upload caused Redis workers to crash with Out-of-Memory (OOM) errors.
incident.root_cause: Workers ingested 50MB PDFs directly into memory as whole buffers rather than stream chunking.
incident.knowledge_feedback: Updated RAG-CHK-001 and added SEC-RAT-001 to enforce streaming file pipelines and maximum 25MB file upload thresholds.

incident.symptom: Concurrent wallet withdrawal requests allowed balance to drop below zero (lost update race condition).
incident.root_cause: Service verified balance in-memory without row-level locking (SELECT FOR UPDATE) before issuing update statement.
incident.knowledge_feedback: Established database-concurrency framework requiring pessimistic row-level locking for all financial balance mutations.

incident.symptom: Pull Request claimed 'Pessimistic Row Locking verified with 15/15 tests passing', but 10 concurrent transfer requests produced a Lost Update bug where 9/10 transfers completed without deducting ledger balances.
incident.root_cause: Agent violated TEST-INT-001 by using an InMemoryTransferRepository that merely recorded IDs into an uninspected Set without actual async blocking. The self-audit workflow lacked a check verifying whether concurrency claims were tested on real PostgreSQL engines or merely on fake in-memory doubles.
incident.knowledge_feedback: Enacted TEST-TRUTH-001 and TEST-RACE-001; updated Gate 6 in workflows/code-review.xml to forbid declaring concurrency verified unless executed against real PostgreSQL or proven by concurrent Promise.all test assertions.

incident.symptom: Pull Request validated UUID idempotencyKey in Zod schema and stored it in database records, but issuing two requests with identical idempotencyKey deducted money twice (double-spending bug).
incident.root_cause: Agent treated schema validation as task completion without implementing the actual business deduplication check (findByIdempotencyKey). The code review gate checked schema presence but lacked a behavioral test assertion verifying duplicate call deduplication.
incident.knowledge_feedback: Enacted BE-IDEM-001 and TEST-IDEM-001; established FW-IDEM-001 idempotency strategy framework; updated Gate 6 in workflows/code-review.xml to mandate duplicate-call behavioral test assertions.
